title: Surrogate inference for threshold-derived environmental indices depends on null placement and seasonal event concentration - reproducibility package
description: Versioned reproducibility package supporting the SERRA submission. It contains the frozen protocols, analysis scripts, row-level and summary outputs, independent-code audit, CMIP6 Amazon reconstruction workflow, figure source data, and figure-generation scripts used to study surrogate-null placement before versus after threshold-based index construction. Version 1.1.0 updates manuscript-facing metadata and environmental framing; the confirmatory protocols and numerical scientific results are unchanged from v1.0.0.
